svg.title: V4 TT-Lang dedicated communication + N-sharded matmul: Four devices
svg.desc: Four devices exchange activation K shards through a ring using four fabric workers and six local distribution workers, concurrently compute N-sharded matmul and bias on 120 workers per device, and optionally gather output shards into replicated M by N DRAM tensors.
svg.text: V4 TT-Lang dedicated communication + N-sharded matmul: Four devices
D=4 · M, K, and N denote global matrix dimensions · physical 2×2 mesh; logical 4×1 participants
Blue: DRAM · green: L1 DFB · orange: fabric · yellow: worker computation · purple: output
Measured activation ring: D0 → D1 → D2 → D3 → D0; three forwarding rounds
Four fabric workers receive and forward; ten column-0 workers distribute activation rows through L1.

g.text: O₀ = A × B₀ + bias₀ · M × N/4
O₁ = A × B₁ + bias₁ · M × N/4
O₂ = A × B₂ + bias₂ · M × N/4
O₃ = A × B₃ + bias₃ · M × N/4

svg.text: Matmul output shards, followed by output all-gather
Each device: Read Oᵣ from DRAM → send L1 blocks to all three peers
Direct fabric transfers · two workers/device · 1×5-tile messages · received L1 blocks copied into DRAM at the source device's N offset
[ O₀ | O₁ | O₂ | O₃ ] = M × N
[ O₀ | O₁ | O₂ | O₃ ] = M × N
[ O₀ | O₁ | O₂ | O₃ ] = M × N
[ O₀ | O₁ | O₂ | O₃ ] = M × N

g.text: Bars are illustrative; four fabric, six local distribution, and 120 compute workers run concurrently.
read/send own A; receive remote A
receive subsequent remote A blocks into L1
receive, multicast, and forward next A blocks
cache/relay next A + stream next B
Source: tt-lang branch bnorris/all-gather-output-replication · dedicated_communication/operation.py · measured 12×10 compute configuration
